import ctypes,json,sys,resource
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE,(0,0))
lib=ctypes.CDLL(sys.argv[1]);f=lib.entrypoint
cases=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint32]*len(cases[0]);f.restype=ctypes.c_uint32
print('STUDY_READY',flush=True)
for i,x in enumerate(cases):
 print('STUDY_CALL',i,flush=True)
 v=f(*x)
 print('STUDY_VALUE',i,v,flush=True)
print('STUDY_DONE',flush=True)
